claims.claim: The headlights is Very neat as new one
claims.evidence: Witness report says the tail light assemblies appear new/unused or in very good condition with no obvious cracks or missing lens pieces visible.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy
claims.evidence: Witness report notes a label/sticker is visible but the text/model is not clearly readable; no OEM/part number is confirmed.

claims.claim: No crack, all clips and brackets complete
claims.evidence: Witness report confirms no obvious cracks/missing lens pieces, but does not show mounting clips/brackets completeness or broken tabs.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk (wrong vehicle make/model/year or wrong side/fitment).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the part number/OEM marking (or label text) and a shot showing the mounting points/shape compared to the vehicle side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used tail light assembly with uncertain fitment.

risks.risk: LED vs bulb type mismatch (or internal wiring/driver issues).
risks.proof: A close-up showing the bulb/LED type area and connector/wiring, plus a photo of the connector pins/part number.

risks.risk: Hidden damage: micro-scratches, internal moisture/condensation, or hairline cracks not visible in the witness shots.
risks.proof: A close-up at an angle of the lens surface and a photo showing the inside of the housing (no fogging) and any OEM markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with potential hidden lens/housing defects.

risks.risk: Missing mounting hardware (clips/brackets) or broken tabs not visible in the witness report.
risks.proof: A photo showing all mounting tabs/clips and the back side of the assembly clearly.

risks.risk: Aftermarket quality risk (even if it looks neat, it may be non-OEM).
risks.proof: Clear OEM marking/part number and a photo of the label text readable enough to verify brand/OEM.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the label/sticker text and any OEM/part number markings (both units).
Send photos of the back side showing mounting clips/brackets/tabs in full view (both units).
Send a close-up of the connector/pins and indicate whether it is LED or bulb type (and the bulb/LED area).
Send a photo showing the lens surface under light to check for micro-scratches and any internal fogging/moisture.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a pair of car tail light assemblies in very good condition with no obvious cracks. However, OEM/origin, exact fitment, and electrical type are not verifiable remotely, so it should be priced at the worst-case assumptions until the requested proof is provided.
